hardcoded_signals._why_token_layer: These two paths shipped pointing at src/theme/** and src/styles/tokens*, NEITHER of which exists in this repo. The real token layer is src/app/tokens.css, so the gate's idea of 'inside the token layer' resolved to nothing. It still caught raw hex in .ts/.tsx (the source globs never included .css), so nothing was being missed in practice, but a token-layer allowlist that matches no file is a gate with a hole waiting for the first person who moves a colour into it.

banned.why: replace with a real product rule this project has actually made. See references/writing-a-gate.md.
